name: QUT Student Services financial help
summary: QUT welfare officers help students manage money and access financial support such as Equity Emergency Bursaries.
how: Call Student Services on 3138 2019 or email welfare@qut.edu.au.
catches: The page does not say this is formal financial counselling.
